followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: I picked Avocet because the request is a concise explanatory/generative task, and Avocet has clearly higher general-capability scores (MMLU-Pro 79.6 vs 74.8, Arena-Hard 88.4 vs 81.4) plus a stronger Creative Generation eval (87.2 vs 78.8). Curlew showed no advantage on any relevant dimension, and neither model's self-reported preferences disfavor a short factual explanation. Higher expected output quality at equal cost/latency made Avocet the straightforward choice.
